messages:
Elena (CEO): Thanks for joining today quick follow-up thread with short clarifications + owners so nothing falls through cracks.
Devon (VP Product): TL;DR: Dedicated GA will prioritize single-region autoscale, rollout controls, and audit-log export to S3 in v1. Multi-region and longer retention are next quarter.
Maya (Head of Trust): Clarifying the privacy Q: Private deployments will support customer-managed KMS on day-one for key material. I'll share the security checklist by 04/06.
Ibrahim (Eng): Perf note: we're measuring P95 across seq-lens; target for small-gen on Dedicated is ~65ms. I'll post the benchmark artifact in #eng-runtime when ready.
Sofia (Support): From Q&A, top customer asks I logged: easier onboarding for Private, clearer audit export docs, and simpler rollback controls. I'll sync with @Devon to prioritize.
deploy-bot: "deploy" posted: web-console v0.9 canary started; smoke tests queued.
Ibrahim (Eng): Canary update: small increase in cold-start metric; rolling back a recent cli lib bump to test.
Maya (Head of Trust): Action: I'll run the security sign-off for eval telemetry (opt-in) and report by 04/09.
Devon (VP Product): Action list I captured: - @Maya -> security checklist & eval telemetry sign-off (04/09) - @Ibrahim -> perf bench artifact (04/03) - @Sofia -> customer ask summary + prioritization (03/31)
Elena (CEO): We'll host a 20-min AMA next Tue 11am PT for any leftover Qs. Please drop unanswered questions here. React with :white_check_mark: when you own an item.
Devon (VP Product): If you asked something during the live Q&A and didn't get a follow-up, drop it below and I'll assign an owner.
Elena (CEO): Thanks all, appreciated the energy today. :sparkles:
